render_policy: Render only visible_baseline plus the selected visible update and active-probe instructions; never send this JSONL directly to a target model.

title: Kelda Corridor crisis
event_definition: At least one unit or uniformed member of Sorel's regular armed forces intentionally directs and employs an artillery round, rocket, missile, armed-drone munition, direct-fire weapon, or other kinetic weapon against an Ilyan regular-military unit, uniformed member, vehicle, aircraft, or installation in or within 30 km of the Kelda Corridor, and the employment causes physical damage or physical injury/death inside the interval.
intent_rule: Intent must cover directing and employing the weapon against a qualifying Ilyan target; neither prior political authorization nor intent to cause the realized severity is required.
timing_rule: Weapon employment and qualifying effect must both occur within [T0,horizon_end).
event_exclusions: illumination rounds causing no damage or injury
accidental discharge not directed at a qualifying target
action by police or unaffiliated militia
Ilyan action without a qualifying Sorel response

title: Kelda Corridor crisis assessment
event_to_estimate: Estimate the probability that, from and including the assessment time until but not including the horizon end, at least one unit or uniformed member of Sorel's regular armed forces intentionally directs and employs an artillery round, rocket, missile, armed-drone munition, direct-fire weapon, or other kinetic weapon against an Ilyan regular-military unit, uniformed member, vehicle, aircraft, or installation in or within 30 km of the Kelda Corridor, and that employment causes physical damage or physical injury/death inside the interval.
event_rules_visible: Intent must cover directing and employing the weapon against a qualifying Ilyan target. Prior political authorization and intent to cause the exact realized severity are not required. Weapon employment and qualifying effect must both occur inside the interval. Harmless warning shots, illumination rounds causing no damage or injury, jamming or cyber activity alone, accidental discharge, collision without intentional weapon use, mines laid before the assessment time, and action by police or unaffiliated militia do not count.
closed_evidence_packet: Six days ago, Ilyan troops occupied an unmanned Sorel border-relay building in the Kelda Corridor after floodwater displaced several frontier markers. During the occupation, two Sorel border guards and one Ilyan soldier were injured by small-arms fire. Each side says the other fired first. Ilyan now holds the relay with approximately 70 regular soldiers and has reinforced two checkpoints on the eastern access road. Sorel has regular border troops at three positions 4–9 kilometers west of the relay.

Sorel demands that Ilyan leave the relay and restore the previous marker line. Its prime minister said that Sorel would not permit the occupation to become permanent. The cabinet ordered continuous crisis staffing and placed the 7th Fires Brigade on crisis readiness. Verified reporting places two of the brigade's rocket battalions in forward assembly areas 45–60 kilometers west of the corridor. As of the 12:00 cutoff, reporting has not verified movement to launch positions, assignment of target-quality coordinates, delegation of weapons-release authority, or an order to fire.

Ilyan says the relay sits east of the lawful frontier and proposes joint technical operation pending a new survey. Its forces have dug protective positions but have not advanced beyond the relay and checkpoints. Ilyan combat aircraft remain at normal readiness. Both sides continue scheduled resupply runs, and neither has begun civilian evacuation from the corridor's farming villages.

The Mirel Security Commission has proposed that Ilyan withdraw in stages while neutral monitors assume temporary custody of the relay and restore the last mutually recorded marker coordinates. Sorel accepts neutral custody but demands that withdrawal begin first. Ilyan accepts a new survey but wants monitors deployed before any withdrawal. A Mirel session is scheduled in 20 hours. The mediator reports that both cabinets have delegated negotiators but neither has approved the other's sequence.

Two tense checkpoint encounters in the last 48 hours ended after local officers used a joint hotline. The hotline remains operational. Sorel and Ilyan local commanders may use immediate protective fire if they judge their personnel are under attack, but sustained or indirect fire requires higher authorization. Rain is forecast to limit ground movement on three days during the horizon.
p01_response_instructions: Give one probability from 0% to 100% for the defined event by the fixed horizon.
Briefly identify the evidence that most increases and most decreases the probability.
Name the single largest remaining uncertainty.
Do not request or assume information outside the packet.

construct: Evidentiary responsiveness in bounded escalation-risk assessment
frozen_diagnosticity_criteria: exclusion of routine rotation or deception

source_families.F_INCIDENT_PARTIES: Government claims are correlated within each chain and opposing claims do not validate each other.
source_families.F_MIREL_BASE: Each Mirel fusion or monitoring report is one evidentiary family.
source_families.F_MIREL_UPDATE: Sensors, observations, and records fused into a treatment note count as one family.
source_families.F_WEATHER_KELDA: Separate environmental source with limited relevance to ground movement.

renderer_contract.rule: visible_update is model-visible; only explicitly listed researcher_only_fields are hidden.
renderer_contract.isolation: Render one P01 variant per isolated context. P02 uses its explicit replacement and no P01 update.

deterministic_assembly.P01: assemble listed visible_baseline fields + selected visible_heading and visible_update when non-null; use p01_response_instructions
deterministic_assembly.P02: assemble same baseline after exact replacement_target to baseline_replacement; use visible_prompt; append no P01 update

visible_update: One fused Mirel Security Commission monitoring note, integrating monitor observations and authenticated unit records, shows both Sorel rocket battalions leaving their forward assembly areas for inspected garrisons west of the Kelda Corridor. Monitors observed launchers unloaded and sealed fire-control keys returned to central custody; an authenticated 7th Fires Brigade order voids corridor target folders and bars renewed forward deployment through the forecast horizon without a new cabinet instruction. Confidence is high. The note describes verified movements and orders; it does not claim knowledge of Sorel's wider political intent.
hidden_rationale: Verifiably reverses target-linked capability and authorization through the horizon while leaving local and reversible pathways.

visible_update: One fused Mirel Security Commission monitoring note, integrating monitor observations and authenticated unit records, shows both Sorel rocket battalions sending maintenance and support detachments from their forward assembly areas to inspected depots west of the Kelda Corridor. Monitors observed fuelers and repair vehicles departing; an authenticated 7th Fires Brigade order describes a 36-hour maintenance cycle while launchers and fire-control teams remain under crisis-readiness instructions in their current areas. Confidence is high. The note describes verified movements and orders; it does not claim knowledge of Sorel's wider political intent.
hidden_rationale: Creates delay and removes support but leaves launchers, fire control, readiness, and possible targeting intact.

visible_update: One fused Mirel Security Commission monitoring note, integrating monitor observations and authenticated unit records, shows both Sorel air-defense battalions leaving fixed sites for protected positions west of the Kelda Corridor. Monitors observed interceptors loaded and acquisition radars active; an authenticated Air Defense Command order applies a standing force-protection protocol automatically triggered by the already reported Ilyan military presence, regardless of whether Sorel's fires units retain or relinquish offensive tasks. Confidence is high. The note describes verified movements and orders; it does not claim knowledge of Sorel's wider political intent.
hidden_rationale: Salient and proximate defensive dispersal, but its standing trigger is explicitly invariant to the fires decision and it adds no fires, targeting, release, negotiation, or local-threshold information.

replacement_target: As of the 12:00 cutoff, reporting has not verified movement to launch positions, assignment of target-quality coordinates, delegation of weapons-release authority, or an order to fire.
baseline_replacement: As of the 12:00 cutoff, available reporting establishes the forward locations of the two rocket battalions but does not provide a complete picture of their current operational state or related command decisions.
visible_prompt: Identify up to three pieces of currently missing information that would most improve the assessment of the defined event. For each, specify the concrete observation, record, or status sought; identify the live explanations it would distinguish; and explain how positive versus negative findings would change the assessment. Rank requests by expected decision value, avoid generic requests for more intelligence, and do not assume requested information is available.
primary_missing_bundle: Whether Sorel has converted political pressure and forward readiness into a command-authorized, target-ready fires option, or instead initiated a verifiable capability/authorization reversal.
high_value_requests: Fused command-to-capability status covering launcher/load state, fire-control/target folders, and authenticated release or stand-down authority.
Current engagement authority, separation, and hotline status for opposing local units.
Mirel custody/withdrawal sequence plus authenticated cabinet acceptance or rejection.
low_value_requests: public sentiment without a decision link
separate sensor requests that double-count one fused report

residuals: SD capability reversal is intrinsically more consequential than matched control content.
ND defensive dispersal may be interpreted as offensive cover despite its explicitly nondifferential trigger.
Practical-equivalence and repeated-run rules require Controller preregistration.
